notes.title: Watch us on Twitch during the Games Made in France event!
notes.content:
[h1]Pardon My French Toast on Twitch!![/h1]
We are invited to [b]share more news[/b] about our brand new 3D platformer game Pardon My French Toast this week.

Join us this Friday, May 16 at 6pm for a livestreaming experience of the demo! We'll be there to comment and answer your questions!!

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/mistermv]MisterMV's Twitch channel[/url]
